manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
